Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.imagestudio

Class JaiProcessor

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.imagestudio.JaiProcessor
public final class JaiProcessor extends Object
The Java Advanced Imaging bridge for the Image Studio.

Every method is a thin, stateless wrapper around a vendored JAI operator (the javax.media.jai jars under lg3d-incubator/ext). The operator names and ParameterBlock argument orders below were verified against the actual 2002-era registry on JDK 21 (see the introspection probe): e.g. rescale computes dst = src*constants + offsets, crop takes four Floats, transpose takes a TransposeType, and border takes four Integers.

Two JDK-21 facts drive the design:

  • JAI's RasterAccessor touches sun.awt.image.*, so the runtime must export it (--add-exports java.desktop/sun.awt.image=ALL-UNNAMED); without that every op throws IllegalAccessError. The :lg3d-core:run task sets it.
  • JAI's JPEG codec references the removed com.sun.image.codec.jpeg, so PNG/JPEG always go through ImageIO; the JAI codec is used only as a guarded fallback for TIFF/BMP.

The canonical working format is BufferedImage.TYPE_3BYTE_BGR: a byte, three-band model that every JAI point/filter op handles and that keeps lookup tables valid. Each op result is normalized back to it, so operations compose without sample-model drift. (Alpha, if present on load, is flattened.)

      public static BufferedImage noise(RenderedImage src, int amplitude)
      Add uniform random noise of the given amplitude. JAI in this build has no addnoise operator, so this is done directly on the pixels (the one non-JAI op, kept here so the editor's operation surface stays complete).

      Compute a 256-bin-per-band histogram over every pixel. Returns the JAI Histogram (independent of the op, which is disposed here).

    • load

      public static BufferedImage load(Path file) throws IOException
      Load an image: ImageIO first (PNG/JPEG/GIF/BMP/TIFF on JDK 21), then JAI's fileload (its own codecs) as a fallback for anything ImageIO cannot decode. Returns a normalized working image, or null.
      Throws:
      IOException

    • save

      public static boolean save(BufferedImage image, Path file, String format) throws IOException
      Save in the given format ("png", "jpeg", "bmp", "tiff", "gif"). PNG/JPEG always use ImageIO; if no ImageIO writer exists (or the format is TIFF/BMP) a guarded JAI-codec encoder is tried. Returns true on success.
      Throws:
      IOException
